title: Study Evaluating the Long-term Safety and Efficacy of VX-445 Combination Therapy
brief_summary: This study evaluated the long-term safety, efficacy, and pharmacodynamics of elexacaftor (ELX, VX-445) in triple combination (TC) with tezacaftor (TEZ) and ivacaftor (IVA) in subjects with cystic fibrosis (CF) who are heterozygous for the F508del mutation and a gating or residual function mutation (F/G and F/RF genotypes).
raw_criteria:
Key Inclusion Criteria:

* Completed study drug treatment in parent study (VX18-445-104); or had study drug interruption(s) in parent study but completed study visits up to the last scheduled visit of the Treatment Period in the parent study

Key Exclusion Criteria:

* History of study drug intolerance in parent study

Other protocol defined Inclusion/Exclusion criteria may apply.
